sam_infra: Heads-up — finance asked for a region-by-region placement analysis for inference clusters (EU vs APAC vs US) to feed the Q2 commitment plan. I sketched some rough per-hour spends but want ops + finance input before we recommend reserves.

maria_finance: Thanks Sam. Can you paste the per-GPU and egress deltas you used? Need numbers to compare against existing committed spend.

sam_infra: Quick snapshot (rough):
```
Region   H100_on_demand  H100_reserved_1yr  %disc  egress_per_GB
us-west  $4.20/hr        $2.94/hr           30%    $0.08/GB
eu-west  $4.80/hr        $3.36/hr           30%    $0.12/GB
ap-northeast  $5.10/hr   $3.57/hr           30%    $0.14/GB
```
Numbers from vendor price sheet + typical 1yr reserved discount. Assumed utilization 60% for amortized per-hour.

kevin_sre: A couple of operational notes:
- APAC capacity often has lower stock of H100s and higher preemption/maintenance windows; expect lower fill rates if we commit heavily there.
- Inter-region egress: serving EU from us-west will add ~40–80ms avg and cost us egress tiers; if traffic is chatty (streaming tokens) egress spikes.

anya_prod: Also data residency/regulatory: some customers in EU require EU-only processing. We can't route those to us-west regardless of cost. We should separate "constrained" traffic vs "global" traffic for placement.

marco_ops: For Dedicated pools, we can mix instance types/regions in a single order with vendor if we lock in a minimum commitment, but the price floor is per-region. Practical approach: buy base committed capacity in US & EU, flex/spot in APAC for spill.

maria_finance: Can we extract last 90 days of actual GPU-hours + egress by region from billing export? I'll run a forecast with a Monte Carlo to estimate needed commit sizes. If you can provide a quick BigQuery filter, I can run it now.

sam_infra: Sure — here's the query we've used before (adapted):
```
SELECT invoice_month, region, sku_description, SUM(usage_amount) as gpu_hours, SUM(cost) as cost_usd
FROM `billing.project.gcp_billing_export`
WHERE sku_description LIKE "%NVIDIA A100%" OR sku_description LIKE "%NVIDIA H100%"
  AND invoice_month BETWEEN "2025-12-01" AND "2026-02-28"
GROUP BY invoice_month, region, sku_description
ORDER BY invoice_month, region;
```
Change timeframe as needed. Also filter for network egress SKU to get egress by region.

kevin_sre: Another metric: per-region pod fill latency and queue depth. If we commit too much in EU but fill under 40% due to traffic variance, we're locked in costs. Can we get a 30-day utilization heatmap per region?

sam_infra: Yes, ops can generate that — will add to the ticket. Quick sanity note: when modeling commit economics, include the latency SLO penalty cost (we measured ~0.5% product churn for responses >200ms for chat workload). For EU traffic, routing to nearby cheaper EU_reserved may actually reduce product churn enough to justify higher region price.

maria_finance: Good call. For decision criteria propose: (1) hard constraints (compliance/residency), (2) latency SLO risk, (3) raw unit cost + egress, (4) fill-rate risk. We'll produce a ranked recommendation per region with commit size bands (low/med/high).

marco_ops: Operational suggestion: instead of 1yr flat reserved, consider a hybrid: 6mo convertible + 1yr base in US. Keeps flexibility for model family shifts and quantization lowering GPU needs. Also check vendor-created spot pools in APAC — sometimes 40% cheaper than on-demand with reasonable stability.

billing-bot: FYI — created billing query job: job_55842. Output is in gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-03-18/region-usage.csv

anya_prod: For rollout plan: if we change placement for a subset of customers, we need canary routing and observability hooks to catch latency regressions quickly. Add per-customer routing tags to the api gateway.

sam_infra: Action items:
- sam_infra: produce 30-day utilization + pod fill heatmap by region (due EOD tomorrow)
- maria_finance: run commit-sizing Monte Carlo using billing export (can start now)
- kevin_sre: identify networking cost anomalies (cross-region peering vs public egress) and list any soft limits that impacted APAC in last 90d
- marco_ops: map available vendor reserved SKUs by region and lead time for procurement

maria_finance: I'll post the commit sizing sheet here when ready, will include expected cost delta vs current monthly spend and break-even utilization for 1yr commit.

kevin_sre: if anyone wants quick roughs for product vs cost tradeoff ping me, I can model latency penalty as $/100ms lost revenue.

sam_infra: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after the data. If anything urgent pops up, DM me. :thumbsup:
